title: Purposeful availment and directed activity
summary: Purposeful availment concerns conduct by which a defendant deliberately engages with a forum and invokes the benefits or protections associated with that activity. Some contexts describe purposeful direction of conduct toward the forum.
notes: Foreseeability that an item or person might reach a state is not itself a complete showing. The readings contain disagreement about intermediated product distribution and about what counts as direction toward a particular state.

sections.Meaning: Purposeful availment concerns conduct by which a defendant deliberately engages with a forum and invokes the benefits or protections associated with that activity. Some contexts describe purposeful direction of conduct toward the forum.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the defendant’s conduct rather than relying only on the plaintiff’s movement or injury. For contracts, inspect solicitation, negotiations, continuing obligations, and the contemplated relationship. For products and intentional torts, use the more specific assigned lines of cases.

priorAccount.title: Purposeful availment
priorAccount.summary: The defendant’s own deliberate forum-directed conduct matters to the jurisdictional connection.
priorAccount.notes: Compare active cultivation of a market or continuing relationship with unilateral conduct by a plaintiff or third party.
